summary: Decoding and writing for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF and WebP (lossy, lossless and animated WebP read through the image-webp crate; WebP written lossless) live in springboard/render/src/cg/imageio, with EXIF, TIFF, GPS, XMP and IPTC metadata, orientation, embedded thumbnails, animation frames, colour-managed decode and lossless metadata edits (copy_image_source). Apps reach them through the SDK: graphics_imageio and image_source for pixels, sizes and fast thumbnails, image_metadata for EXIF, GPS, descriptive metadata, upright decode and lossless edits (edit, without_location), image_animation for frames and delays, and picture_writer for writing with metadata and destination options (max side, background, embedded preview, sharing). Not yet verified on Midget. No HEIC, TGA or RAW, and no HDR gain maps.

Tests: webp::tests::a_lossy_picture_decodes, an_animated_picture_gives_every_frame_its_delay_and_the_loop_count. Remaining gap: decode stays synchronous and whole-picture for every format but PNG regions; not verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-19: TiledPicture decodes a picture file once and serves its tiles through the TileCache (region, tile, crop_tile; tests a_tiled_picture_serves_the_region_and_remembers_the_tiles, the_cache_bounds_the_tiles_held_and_evicts_the_oldest, a_picture_file_is_decoded_and_tiled_and_bad_input_is_refused in image_tiles.rs). gaps: HEIC, TGA and RAW are not decoded; WebP is written lossless and still only (no lossy or animated WebP writer).
No general CGImageMetadata tag tree (paths, qualifiers, structures): XMP is read and written for the descriptive fields only, and TIFF files carry no XMP or IPTC.

copy_image_source rewrites JPEG, PNG and WebP; TIFF is refused. An edit of only the orientation, the dates, the XMP packet or the descriptive fields patches the EXIF block in place and keeps maker notes and offset tags; an edit that adds, replaces or removes EXIF, TIFF or GPS tags rebuilds the block and drops the maker notes and the interoperability and sub-IFD pointers. A JPEG IPTC block is rewritten whole from the descriptive fields (other datasets and image resources in it are not kept).
No HDR gain maps or HDR/SDR decode requests; images are converted to the display profile on decode and to sRGB when optimised for sharing.
Without an embedded preview the whole picture is decoded before scaling (no DCT-scaled JPEG decode); only still PNG has a region decode.
The Photos and camera code still use their own encoders (springboard/src/pngenc.rs) and are not moved onto picture_writer.
Image data does not travel with a drag yet (needs the shell protocol).
Not yet verified on Midget: every row built on parity/team-n-image-i-o and parity/image-io.
